name: Sandbox Builder
description: Creative mode with snap-grid construction and simulation toggles.
objective: Build a structure, inject heat, then watch fracture risk climb.

name: Fluid Puzzle
description: Route water through destructible voxel channels.
objective: Move 40 units of water to the target zone.

name: Arena Runner
description: Small starter action mode with moving hazards and pickups.
objective: Survive waves while the world changes around you.

name: Colony Agents
description: Spawn AI agents and give them resource tasks.
objective: Keep energy, heat and structure stability balanced.
